name: Trick DS-ban ~Kakushigami no Sumu Yakata~
original_name: TRICK DS版 〜隠し神の棲む館〜
source:
Based in the hit TBS drama.

Although 23-year-old Naoko Yamada considers herself a beautiful and talented magician, she is continuously fired and constantly hounded by her landlady for the rent being late. Before firing her, her manager shows Yamada an ad for a physics professor, Jiro Ueda, a non-believer of all things magical, offering money to anyone who can prove to him that magic is real. Desperately needing the money, Naoko accepts the challenge, which is how she comes to meet Professor Ueda. Falling prey to her simple magic tricks, Ueda is impressed, and enlists the reluctant Naoko to help him uncover the tricks behind a local cult. Soon, they are debunking spiritualists. Eventually Ueda develops a reputation for solving supernatural cases, but his secret weapon is Yamada, who hates the work but needs the money.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trick_(TV_series)]Wikipedia[/url]]

In the game, Naoko and Professor Ueda travel to a mysterious village to solve the mystery of a haunted house where everyone who enters is killed.
translation:
改编自热门TBS电视剧。

23岁的山田直子自认为是一位美丽且才华横溢的魔术师，但她却不断被解雇，并因拖欠房租而不断受到女房东的骚扰。在解雇她之前，她的经理向山田展示了一则招聘物理学教授上田次郎的广告，他不相信所有魔法，向任何能向他证明魔法真实存在的人提供金钱。由于急需钱，直子接受了挑战，这就是她遇到上田教授的原因。上田被她简单的魔术所吸引，留下了深刻的印象，并邀请不情愿的直子帮助他揭开当地邪教背后的诡计。很快，他们就揭穿了唯灵论者的谎言。最终上田因解决超自然案件而享有盛誉，但他的秘密武器是山田，他讨厌这项工作但需要钱。

[来自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trick_(TV_series)]维基百科[/url]]

在游戏中，直子和上田教授前往一个神秘的村庄，解开一座鬼屋的谜团，所有进入的人都被杀死。
